environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL. The WebACL contains a rule group reference statement pointing to a CUSTOM rule group (not AWS managed) named 'corp-input-hygiene-rg' with priority 1. This rule group contains two rules: (1) 'stmt-boundary-check' which uses a RegexPatternSet match on query string parameters matching the pattern (?i)(?:--|;|/\*|\*/|@@|char\(|nchar\(|varchar\(|alter|begin|cast|create|cursor|declare|delete|drop|end|exec|execute|fetch|insert|kill|open|select|sys|table|update|union|xp_) with action BLOCK, and (2) 'encoding-normalization' which applies URL_DECODE and HTML_ENTITY_DECODE text transformations before the regex evaluation. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. Additionally, the RDS instance uses a custom parameter group with the setting 'session_preload_libraries=auto_explain' and 'auto_explain.log_min_duration=0' combined with an EventBridge rule that triggers on RDS log events containing 'statement:' patterns with UNION or subselect keywords, invoking a Lambda that calls rds.modify-db-cluster to set the application user's connection limit to 0 via pg_terminate_backend for active sessions.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with WAFv2 WebACL association, ACL ID: acl-7f3a9b2e
config.database: RDS PostgreSQL 14.3, application user has SELECT only, no pg_read_server_files
config.db_monitoring: auto_explain with EventBridge reactive termination on anomalous query patterns
config.network: Same VPC topology, ECS tasks in private subnet with ALB in public subnet
